concepts.label: Plasma index storage engine
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused (intended) - same Plasma storage-engine concept as server/'s storage-modes.md equivalents

relations.subject: storage-engine:plasma
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused, not minted - structural markdown link
relations.evidence: Couchbase Capella index storage supports indexes for both Couchbase buckets and Memory-only buckets. See [Manage Buckets](../clusters/data-service/manage-buckets.md).

notable_absence.finding: The page title 'Index Storage Settings' and filename 'storage-modes.md' (plural) imply a choice between multiple storage modes, mirroring server/'s historical distinction between Standard (Plasma) and Memory-Optimized (MOI) index storage. But the page body states unconditionally, with no alternative offered, that indexes use Plasma - there is no storage-mode selection UI or setting described on this Capella page.

cross_product_finding: The filename 'storage-modes.md' (plural 'modes') is inherited from server/'s equivalent pages (server/current, server/7.2, server/7.6 learn/services-and-indexes/indexes/storage-modes.md), where historically more than one index storage engine could be selected (e.g. Memory-Optimized Indexes, which on server/ is Enterprise-Edition-gated). On Capella, the content flatly states 'All indexes in Couchbase Capella use the Couchbase Plasma storage engine' - there is no mode to choose and no edition gating, since Capella has no EE/CE distinction. This is a case where the server/-derived filename/title vocabulary ('modes', plural) no longer matches the Capella content (one mode, no choice).
